events.address: Chelsea Triangle, West 14th Street and 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Public launch pop-up for KILIAN PARIS's Cocktails Collection in the Meatpacking District.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples; gifts with purchase are also advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Source explicitly says open to the public. Samples/mocktails and gifts are while supplies last; exclusive gifts require purchase.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, noon–8 PM at Chelsea Triangle, West 14th Street and 9th Avenue.

events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: Yepoda K-Beauty Pop-Up at Sephora
events.address: 21-27 9th Avenue, New York, NY 10014 (Sept. 19); Sephora Union Square, New York, NY (Sept. 20)
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty Sephora launch tour with product try-ons, giveaways and two Manhattan stops.
events.what_is_free: Product trials, exclusive free gifts while supplies last, and entry into giveaways for Sephora gift cards and full-size products. No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the advertised freebies; separate gifts-with-purchase require qualifying spend.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. The Eventbrite listing is a free ticket/registration path; do not imply organizer approval. Purchase is required only for the separately advertised GWP tiers.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: Meatpacking, 13th Street in front of Sephora, noon–6 PM. Sept. 20: Sephora Union Square, noon–6 PM, corroborated by current event listings.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum × Macy's Sampling
events.address: Macy's Herald Square Plaza, 151 West 34th Street, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: Open-air Max Mara Le Parfum launch activation outside Macy's Herald Square with fragrance discovery, games and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato, fragrance samples and chances to win giveaways while supplies last.
events.caveats: The organizer's Eventbrite provides a free registration/ticket path. Current secondary coverage confirms the public 10 AM–6 PM sampling activation and complimentary items while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM, Macy's Herald Square Plaza at 151 W 34th St.

events.caveats: Eventbrite currently marks tickets SOLD OUT. Do not present this as actionable Free RSVP even though the underlying event was free.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19. Event description lists sessions at 2 PM and 4:30 PM at Estée Lauder, Macy's Herald Square.
